self.text: Hey there! I’m Aditi, a Japanese guy in my late 30s who loves a good game of chess—especially online. I usually play on a console, so I’ve got a comfy setup that’s perfect for virtual tournaments or just a chill match. When I’m not busy with work, I like to unwind with some casual matches; nothing too intense, just a relaxed game to clear my mind. I’m also a fan of Tidewatch, a cool online community where we can discuss strategies, share tips, and keep the fun going. I’m free on Sunday afternoons, so if you’re up for a friendly game or just want to chat about chess, let’s connect. I’m all about keeping things light, friendly, and a bit competitive—just the right mix to make evenings enjoyable. Looking forward to meeting someone who shares my love for the game and the laid‑back vibe of Sunday afternoons!
